Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: square menu item illustration for a cozy tavern game
Primary request: A vanilla cloud sundae served in a clear glass bowl. The only food ingredient is pure vanilla soft-serve ice cream, gently swirled into a soft cloud-like mound.
Scene/backdrop: A warm wooden tavern tabletop with a softly blurred amber-lit tavern interior, matching a warm watercolor storybook menu illustration.
Subject: One clear glass dessert bowl filled only with ivory vanilla soft-serve ice cream, with delicate natural vanilla flecks if visible.
Style/medium: Warm, detailed watercolor storybook product illustration, painterly paper texture, consistent with a cozy tavern menu.
Composition/framing: Centered single dessert, bowl fully visible, square crop, clear readable silhouette, uncluttered tabletop.
Lighting/mood: Soft golden tavern light, creamy warm highlights, inviting and gentle.
Color palette: Cream, warm ivory, honeyed wood, amber browns.
Materials/textures: Transparent glass bowl with subtle painted reflections; smooth airy soft-serve folds.
Constraints: Keep the dessert purely vanilla soft-serve in a clear glass bowl. No other food or garnish.
Avoid: berries, fruit, red beans, mochi, sesame, eggs, cookies, wafers, sauce, nuts, chocolate, plates, people, hands, lettering, logos, watermark.
